image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small wild rabbit (cottontail) sitting on dry, sandy ground amidst sparse vegetation and dried plant matter. The rabbit is facing left, showing its profile. A second rabbit's rear end is partially visible in the bottom left corner. The lighting is natural daylight, casting soft shadows.
